Avoid harsh soaps, douches, and scented products, opting for mild, fragrance-free cleansers. Loose-fitting cotton underwear can also help reduce irritation. Applying a cool compress may provide temporary relief. Over-the-counter pain relievers like ibuprofen or acetaminophen can help manage pain.

Schedule a follow-up appointment with your healthcare provider within 2-4 weeks if your symptoms don't improve with self-care, or if they worsen. Your cautious approach to medical risks is noted, and this timeline balances self-management with prompt evaluation if needed.
